audit.why: 48.28% over 261 games with difficulty 8.5/10 fits: Steadfast Presence is a hard structural counter to a dash-dependent kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was marked Fiora and First item was marked Poppy, both against the packet chart and against the page's own text.
audit.why: packet.levelChart gives Skill at both. whys[0] calls level 1 'a coin-flip'; whys[5] says the lane 'stays a coin-flip into the mid game'.
audit.corrected: win[0]=Skill, win[5]=Skill with matching phases[N].side flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credits Poppy's Q with a knockup, and no cooldowns appear anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's Hammer Shock text: she swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that slows and explodes after a delay. There is no knockup on her Q — the only knockup in the kit is Keeper's Verdict. Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s and grounds a stopped dash; Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s and is the immobilise Riposte converts into a stun; Keeper's Verdict is a 140/120/100s channel.
audit.corrected: Q knockup removed from whys[1], whys[2] and wants.foe[1]; timers written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: 20s at rank 1 is a long window — the feint is worth it precisely because the punish lasts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict's channel was never mentioned as interruptible.
audit.why: The kit flags it as a channel — your Riposte's disable, or any CC, cancels it. That is a live counterplay the page omitted.

edits.before: With Steadfast Presence up she stops my dash and cancels my Vital chains — my whole engage pattern stalls and she trades back with her Q knockup.
edits.after: With Steadfast Presence up she stops your dash and grounds you, so the Vital chain stalls and her Hammer Shock zone slows and detonates on you.

edits.before: She lands E (Heroic Charge) to pin me against a wall for the stun into Q knockup — that's her trade window, not mine.
edits.after: She lands E (Heroic Charge) to pin you on a wall for the stun, then Hammer Shock on top — her trade window, not yours.

edits.before: Land E (Heroic Charge) to pin you against a wall for the stun, then follow with Q knockup to chunk you
edits.after: Land E (Heroic Charge) to pin you against a wall for the stun, then drop Hammer Shock (Q) to chunk you

edits.before: - Poppy Steadfast Presence: matchup-defining — Grounds you + blocks your Q dash. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Steadfast Presence: 20s at rank 1 — feint a step-in, make her burn it, then Lunge. - Heroic Charge: 14s; parry the wall-pin and it returns as a stun. - Keeper's Verdict is a 140s channel — any CC of yours cancels it.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Poppy, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Poppy, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until her bar forces the all-in she loses.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'With Steadfast Presence' and 'Her Heroic Charge' — both FALSE POSITIVES, correct names with a leading word.
